notes.title: Patchnote 1
notes.content:
Hi!
The game was released 2 days ago, and it's really cool that you like it, I really like it!
You also notified me some bugs in the game that I noticed and patched here :

[b]Important bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Spamming the dialogs does not softlock the game anymore.
[/list]

[b]Minor bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] the game will no longer start in RV
[i](UE4 has VR plugins enabled by default, without VR headphones on my side not easy to see but a player explained it to me in dm, so it's done!)[/i]
[*] Pierrick won't get up again if you kill him. [i](stay down demon!) [/i]
You can no longer see through the curtains of the infirmary.
[*] Correction of some TPs.
[*] Menu SFXs have been lowered. [i](yes, they were loud) [/i]
[*] You can no longer get through the toilet walls. [i](probably the most reported bug) [/i]
[*] Improvement of the level design.
[i](note: Some people have managed to make big detours in the game when the paths were not blocked, now it's not possible to fall on parts of the map where you're not supposed to go) [/i]
[*] Miscellaneous corrections in the French and English translations of the game.
[*] Miscellaneous patches.
[/list]

notes.title: BETA
notes.content:
I'm ecstatic at the idea of going into beta! Steam finally validated the build of the game and now we are advanced enough to launch the more intensive tests!

This is what the beta means at the moment: 
[list]
[*] All the NPCs are there, functional and have their dialogues and quests.
[*] All the endings of the game are accessible.
[*] 80% of the achievements are achievable.
[*] All the backgrounds are there.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244864/cfdadc1d24c59ba1d54bfdd30da00b260f76563b.jpg[/img]


During the next few weeks I will focus on fine-tuning the game and fixing the bugs found by the beta testers and on top of that I have different goals to achieve:
[list]
[*] Translation of the game into English.
[*] Creation of the collectible documents.
[*] Global optimization of the game.
[*] Creation of unique assets to help tracking in the game.
[/list]

Music also comes into the game thanks to Neku who works hard to make the sound atmosphere crazy!

I'm even a bit ahead of schedule right now so I plan to release some devlog on Youtube and if I have time, add some additional content! (provided that the beta goes well)

On that note, I'll let you know soon!

notes.title: ALPHA
notes.content:
Finally, that's it, the game has just reached its first big stage; alpha.
It's very subjective but this is what it means for BLARI project, the game is finishable.

[list]
[*]All enemies are here.
[*]Every zone has its very distinct look.
[*]Every primordial asset is here.
[*]All important interactions are working.
[/list] 

The game having [b] several endings [/ b] for the moment, only the base end is accessible, the next steps will be for me to refine the alpha with always more details and benchmarks in the levels (because everything looks a bit alike at the moment), add more sound effects to make the game more immersive and act on the points that will be noted over the alpha-tests.

I regularly post info on the game on Twitter, and I keep Steam for big occasions. (https://twitter.com/projetBLARI)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244864/1dd3195c58a455ed468a80fc54c79eead4f0fa2e.jpg[/img]
(Just a small break and i'm back)

There is still a lot of work to do however, the two big remaining points being the quests and the lore elements of the game, I still have a few weeks to do this and once that is done the game will finally arrive in Beta and no. will only have to be tested intensively to be able to appear!

I can't wait to show you all!

Max'
